# Licensed semantic-grounding photo baseline

This directory is a deliberately small, source-controlled quality baseline. It is not user data and does not prove production readiness. Exact source URLs, retrieval date, byte size, SHA-256, license, author, queries, and manual boxes are locked in `manifest.json`.

Redistributed files:

- `big-mac-hamburger.jpg` — Evan-Amos, CC0, from Wikimedia Commons.
- `evian-label-free-bottle.jpg` — James Tamim, CC BY-SA 4.0, from Wikimedia Commons.
- `coffee-powder.jpg` — MCMAZ Lunggma, CC0, from Wikimedia Commons.

The CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution and source page are preserved in the manifest. Do not replace these files without updating the source metadata, byte size, SHA-256, dimensions, manual boxes, and evaluation reports in the same commit.
